name: EasyPrint
description: Press Print Screen to copy a screenshot of the game to your clipboard - no crashes, no hassle.

block-system-screenshot.name: Block Windows Print Screen
block-system-screenshot.description: While Geometry Dash is the active window, stop Windows from handling Print Screen itself (Snipping Tool popping up, the game minimizing or freezing). EasyPrint takes the screenshot instead.

show-notification.name: Show Notification
show-notification.description: Show a small notification after the screenshot has been copied.

save-to-file.name: Also Save To File
save-to-file.description: Besides copying to the clipboard, also save every screenshot as a .bmp file in the mod's save folder (<cy>screenshots</c>).
